records.text: --- Source: P3109/D1 3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation, printed page 16; 33-48.
fmod P3109-REAL-EXPRESSIONS is
including P3109-OMEGA-EXTREMA .
ops realAdd realMultiply : Real Real -> Real [ctor] .
ops realNegate realAbs : Real -> Real [ctor] .
op realDivide : Real Real ~> Real [ctor] .
op piMultiple : Rat -> Real [ctor] .
op pi : -> Real .
vars U V : Real .
vars R S : Rat .
var I : Infinity .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-001] : pi = piMultiple(1) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-002] : piMultiple(0) = fin(0) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-003] : realAdd(fin(R), fin(S)) = fin(R + S) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-004] : realAdd(fin(0), U) = U [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-005] : realAdd(U, fin(0)) = U [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-006] : realAdd(piMultiple(R), piMultiple(S)) = piMultiple(R + S) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-007] : realMultiply(fin(R), fin(S)) = fin(R * S) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-008] : realMultiply(fin(0), U) = fin(0) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-009] : realMultiply(U, fin(0)) = fin(0) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-010] : realMultiply(fin(1), U) = U [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-011] : realMultiply(U, fin(1)) = U [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-012] : realMultiply(fin(R), piMultiple(S)) = piMultiple(R * S) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-013] : realMultiply(piMultiple(S), fin(R)) = piMultiple(R * S) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-014] : realNegate(fin(R)) = fin(- R) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-015] : realNegate(piMultiple(R)) = piMultiple(- R) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-016] : realNegate(realNegate(U)) = U [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-017] : realAbs(fin(R)) = fin(abs(R)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-018] : realAbs(piMultiple(R)) = piMultiple(abs(R)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-019] : realDivide(fin(R), fin(S)) = fin(R / S) if S =/= 0 [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-020] : realDivide(piMultiple(R), piMultiple(S)) = fin(R / S) if S =/= 0 [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-021] : realDivide(piMultiple(R), fin(S)) = piMultiple(R / S) if S =/= 0 [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
cmb [p3109-real-divide-domain] : realDivide(U, V) : Real if xEq(V, fin(0)) == false [metadata "clause=4.10.5; page=37"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-022] : omegaAdd(U, V) = realAdd(U, V) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-023] : omegaMultiply(U, V) = realMultiply(U, V) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-024] : omegaNegate(U) = realNegate(U) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-025] : omegaAbs(U) = realAbs(U) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-026] : omegaDivide(U, V) = nan if xEq(V, fin(0)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-027] : omegaDivide(U, V) = realDivide(U, V) if xEq(V, fin(0)) == false [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-028] : omegaMultiply(I, U) = nan if xEq(U, fin(0)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .

fields.label: p3109-real-expressions-029
fields.rhs: if xMinus(I) == xMinus(U) then posInf else negInf fi

records.text: ceq [p3109-real-expressions-029] : omegaMultiply(I, U) = if xMinus(I) == xMinus(U) then posInf else negInf fi if xEq(U, fin(0)) == false [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .

fields.label: p3109-real-expressions-030
fields.rhs: if xMinus(I) == xMinus(U) then posInf else negInf fi

records.text: ceq [p3109-real-expressions-030] : omegaDivide(I, U) = if xMinus(I) == xMinus(U) then posInf else negInf fi if xEq(U, fin(0)) == false [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-031] : xEq(U, U) = true [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-032] : xEq(piMultiple(R), piMultiple(S)) = (R == S) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-033] : xEq(piMultiple(R), fin(0)) = (R == 0) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-034] : xEq(fin(0), piMultiple(R)) = (R == 0) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-035] : xLt(piMultiple(R), piMultiple(S)) = (R < S) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-036] : xLt(piMultiple(R), fin(0)) = (R < 0) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-037] : xLt(fin(0), piMultiple(R)) = (R > 0) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
eq [p3109-real-expressions-038] : xMinus(U) = xLt(U, fin(0)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-039] : xSign(U) = -1 if xLt(U, fin(0)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-040] : xSign(U) = 0 if xEq(U, fin(0)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-expressions-041] : xSign(U) = 1 if xLt(fin(0), U) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.10; mathematical expression representation; page=16; 33-48"] .
ceq [p3109-real-zero-divide] : realDivide(fin(0), V) = fin(0) if xEq(V, fin(0)) == false [metadata "clause=4.10.5; page=37"] .
eq [p3109-real-unit-divide] : realDivide(U, fin(1)) = U [metadata "clause=4.10.5; page=37"] .
endfm
